title: AreaObjects
description:
Everything placed around a point of a worldspace, as the game shows
it, for looking at the place closely (ADR 0038).

objects.description: The objects, with a model, in no particular order.

radius.description: How far around the point, in game units, in each direction.

world.description: The worldspace, by its internal name.

id.description: The reference: the plugin that placed it first and its number there.

model.description: Its model, below the data directory.

name.description: The name players see, or else the internal one.

plugin.description: The plugin whose version the game uses.

rotation.description: Turned about the x, y and z axes, in radians.

scale.description: The size relative to the base object.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.
